text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: billing-metering service detected token_count drift in eu-west-1 emitter pipeline. Elevated overage flags for ~0.7% of customers. Paging eng-oncall and billing oncall. Investigate and coordinate here.
Priya: got it, I'm on call. starting triage — checking emitter logs and shadow pipeline metrics.
Jordan: pinged infra team to check kafka consumer lag and backpressure. I can look at recent deploys.
Sam: any customer-facing alerts already sent? we should hold if possible until we know root cause.
Priya: quick look: emitter consumer lag spiked ~00:12UTC, then resumed. But token dedupe stage shows duplicate window writes in a 3-min window. suspect replay from emitter retries.
Alex: FYI runbook snippet: `./scripts/check-emitter.sh --cluster eu-west-1 --from 00:00 --to now` returns many retries with code 503 -> can confirm replay.
Priya: confirmed duplicates. customers with high concurrent requests saw inflated token counts -> triggered overage flags. Impact: delayed usage recon + some temporary overage emails for ~120 accounts. working on mitigation plan.
BillingTeam: copying in billing. please freeze automated overage emails and pause billing alerts for eu-west-1 until we reconcile. we'll need a hold window and manual review.
Jordan: infra says a recent autoscaler churned a pod and emitter client retried aggressively (exponential backoff misconfigured). Root cause appears to be backoff policy regression from last release.
Sam: mitigation idea: 1) disable emitter retries for 10m, 2) rollback backoff change in canary, 3) kick off dedupe backfill to remove duplicate windows.
Priya: executing step 1 now: toggling retry flag in feature-flag service -> `ffctl set emitter.strict_backoff eu-west-1 false`.
Alex: command run OK. logs show reduced retry loop. :thumbsup:
Priya: step 2 scheduled: rolling back the backoff patch from release v2.14.3 to v2.14.2 on canary groups. will roll further if stable.
BillingTeam: muting overage email webhook on prod (eu-west-1) now. patching billing rule to ignore spikes with duplicate signature id for the hold period.
Jordan: starting consumer group scrub to remove duplicate messages from the window processor: `kafka-consumer-reset --group window-processor --to-offsets safe-point` (doing dry-run first).
Sam: we should also run query to identify affected accounts for manual credits: suggestion SQL: `SELECT account_id,count(*) FROM usage_windows WHERE window_ts BETWEEN X AND Y GROUP BY account_id HAVING count(*)>expected_threshold;`
Priya: running that now, will push list to billing ops. estimated affected: ~120 accounts, majority low-value, 8 enterprise customers flagged — cc @BillingTeam for priority.
BillingTeam: acknowledged. preparing manual credit runbook and customer comm. Recommend holding notice until we confirm reconciler outcome.
Alex: starting dedupe backfill job on staging for verification. backfill job: `python backfill/dedupe_windows.py --cluster eu-west-1 --start 00:10 --end 00:20 --dry-run` — staging dry-run looks good.
Priya: launching prod dedupe with concurrency=4 and monitoring token counts and overage flags. will update in 5m increments.
incidents-bot: note: incident severity bumped to SEV-2 due to customer-impacting overages. responders: Priya (oncall), Jordan, Sam, Alex, BillingTeam.
Sam: quick customer note draft: "We observed a transient token counting anomaly in eu-west-1 that may have caused temporary overage notifications for a small set of customers. We're pausing automated alerts, correcting usage records, and will follow up with any account-specific credits."
BillingTeam: approve draft. we'll send after dedupe completes and we have confirmed reconciliation metrics.
Priya: dedupe job running — progress 35% — no new overage flags in the last 2 minutes.
Jordan: kafka lag back to normal. autoscaler churn root cause: pod oom at midnight; adding OOM alert to avoid silent restarts.
Alex: rolling patch to fix backoff logic now approved. deploying canary to 3 pods.
Priya: dedupe completed 100%. reconciling tokens vs pre-incident snapshot. preliminary delta: net -0.9% tokens (expected correction).
BillingTeam: recon complete, manual credits prepared for affected enterprise accounts, credit script ready: `billing/credit_accounts --batch-file affected_enterprise.csv`.
Sam: recommend postmortem and change: add stricter retry caps + add idempotency key for windows writes to prevent future duplicates.
Priya: agreed. opening postmortem ticket and linking this thread. immediate action items: freeze emails, rollback backoff, dedupe backfill, apply OOM alert.
incidents-bot: incident resolved (SEV-2 -> monitored). If counts re-spike, re-open channel. :white_check_mark:
Priya: closing handoff to oncall rotation notes. will follow up with postmortem doc and customer comm timeline.
